description: Template ICP. Replace with your real targeting before running live batches.
dealbreakers: Existing customer or open opportunity in CRM
Sanctioned country or on the suppression list

qualification.notes: Hard gates disqualify only on verified evidence of a dealbreaker; unknown values never disqualify, they hold. Missing evidence earns zero points and is listed in missingFields. Each signal type has a warmth tier (5 hand-raise, 4 engagement, 3 trigger event, 2 fit, 1 data only) and points; a warmer tier never earns fewer points than a colder one. Signal points decay linearly to zero at maxSignalAgeDays; only the strongest fresh signal counts. A pass needs score >= passThreshold and no missing required fields. Below holdThreshold is a poor fit and is disqualified with score 0. CRM and suppression dealbreakers are enforced at activation, not here.
